mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM sys_account a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.phone = #{phone} AND a.source_flag = #{sourceFlag}
SELECT IFNULL(a.nick_name,u.nick_name) AS nick_name, a.*, u.nick_name AS user_name FROM sys_account a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(a.nick_name,a.nick_name) AS nick_name, a.* FROM sys_account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.source_flag = #{sourceFlag} LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.source_flag = #{sourceFlag} LIMIT 1 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_account a WHERE a.user_id != #{userId} AND a.account_code = #{accountCode} LIMIT 1 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END

SELECT IFNULL(r.nick_name,a.nick_name) AS nick_name, a.* FROM sys_account a WHERE a.account_code = #{accountCode} AND a.source_flag = #{sourceFlag} AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
